Title: Public Preview: Managed identity support for scaling rules in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
You can now use managed identities in your scale rules to authenticate with supported Azure services. This can be done using the Azure CLI or Azure Resource Manager (ARM.) We recommend using managed identity whenever possible to avoid storing secrets within the app.

Learn more.
